description: Vendor-documented size caps on always-loaded guidance, per harness. scope per-file-after-includes caps each projected always-on file after its includes are expanded; combined-chain caps everything a harness loads at startup together. cap_bytes is null when the vendor documents no byte cap; source_url is then the page checked. Never estimate a number. Read by test/guards/guidance-caps.test.ts (G74).

caps.note: 4 MiB per CLAUDE.md file loaded at launch; a larger file is skipped entirely. The page's 200-line target is advice, not a cap.
project_doc_max_bytes, 32 KiB by default: Codex stops adding AGENTS.md files once the combined size reaches it.
No cap documented; the context-file loader reads each file whole.
No cap documented for the CLI. A 4,000-character limit for code review only is cited secondhand and is not in the current docs.
No size cap documented for steering files.
Antigravity truncates any single rule file over 24,000 bytes after expanding @[label](path) includes.
All active global and always_on rules share a 20,000-token budget; over it the largest are demoted to pointers. Tokens, not bytes, so no byte cap is recorded.
